mm1.title: One clerk, one queue (M/M/1): the mean time a customer spends in the shop

mmc.title: Three agents, one queue (M/M/3): the mean wait before a call is answered

md1.title: A machine with a fixed cycle time (M/D/1): the mean wait before a job starts

tandem.title: Two machines in a row (tandem M/M/1 queues): the mean time a part spends in the line

rework.title: Machining and inspection with rework (a Jackson network): the mean time a job is in the shop

priority.title: Urgent jobs go first (a non-preemptive priority M/M/1 queue): the mean time of an urgent job

batch.title: Trays of five through a tunnel oven (batching): the mean time of an item

carpark.title: A car park with ten spaces and no queue (an Erlang loss system): the share turned away

shift.title: A robot that works 65 minutes and charges 35 (a capacity schedule): the mean time of a parcel

cooling.title: A cup of coffee cooling (system dynamics, one stock): its temperature after 15 minutes

repair.title: Twenty machines that fail and are repaired (agents with two states): how many run on average

tank.title: A tank filled by a pump on a timer and drawn from steadily (rates): the share of time it is empty
